seo.title: 35 Portfolio Project Ideas for Web3 Community Managers
seo.description: Discover portfolio project ideas for Web3 community managers. From Discord growth to governance facilitation, build a portfolio that showcases your community expertise.

content.intro: Web3 community management is about building genuine engagement and helping communities thrive. These projects demonstrate the skills that make great community managers.

sections.heading: Discord and Community Building
sections.description: Projects showcasing Discord and community platform expertise.

items.title: Build a Themed Discord Server
items.description: Create and grow a Discord around a Web3 niche. Document your growth strategies.

items.title: Discord Bot Configuration Portfolio
items.description: Document your expertise with Discord bots: verification, moderation, engagement tools.

items.title: Moderation Playbook
items.description: Create a comprehensive moderation guide with policies, escalation procedures, and templates.

items.title: Engagement Program Design
items.description: Design an engagement program with activities, rewards, and participation tracking.

items.title: Community Health Dashboard
items.description: Build a dashboard tracking community health metrics: activity, sentiment, growth.

items.title: Onboarding Flow Optimization
items.description: Design and test an optimized onboarding flow for new community members.

items.title: Community Newsletter
items.description: Run a community newsletter with updates, highlights, and member spotlights.

items.title: Weekly Community Recap
items.description: Create weekly video or written recaps of community activity and achievements.

items.title: FAQ and Knowledge Base
items.description: Build comprehensive FAQ documentation for a Web3 project.

items.title: Crisis Communication Templates
items.description: Create templates for various crisis scenarios: hacks, downtime, controversies.

items.title: Community Voice Style Guide
items.description: Develop a style guide for community communications that matches brand voice.

sections.heading: Events and Programs
sections.description: Show your ability to create and run programs.

items.title: AMA Series Organization
items.description: Organize and host an AMA series. Document your process and learnings.

items.title: Community Call Series
items.description: Run regular community calls with structure, engagement, and follow-up.

items.title: Hackathon Organization
items.description: Organize a community hackathon from planning to judging to prizes.

items.title: Ambassador Program
items.description: Design and launch an ambassador program with tiers, responsibilities, and rewards.

items.title: Community Contests
items.description: Run creative contests (memes, art, content) with fair judging and rewards.

items.title: Education Workshop Series
items.description: Create and run educational workshops for community members.

items.title: Governance Facilitation Log
items.description: Document your role facilitating governance discussions and votes.

items.title: Proposal Summary Service
items.description: Create plain-language summaries of governance proposals for community understanding.

items.title: Governance Participation Analysis
items.description: Analyze and report on governance participation patterns and trends.

items.title: Delegation Campaign
items.description: Run a delegation awareness campaign to increase governance participation.

items.title: Governance Documentation
items.description: Create comprehensive governance documentation for a DAO.

items.title: Monthly Community Report
items.description: Create template and produce monthly community health reports.

items.title: Sentiment Analysis
items.description: Track and report on community sentiment using tools or manual analysis.

items.title: Growth Funnel Analysis
items.description: Map and optimize the community growth funnel from discovery to active member.

items.title: Feedback Collection System
items.description: Design and implement a system for collecting and acting on community feedback.

gettingStarted.title: Join and participate in communities
gettingStarted.description: Be an active member before trying to manage communities.

gettingStarted.title: Volunteer to help
gettingStarted.description: Offer to help existing community managers. Learn by doing.

gettingStarted.title: Build your own community
gettingStarted.description: Start small. A focused niche community teaches more than a large unfocused one.

gettingStarted.title: Document everything
gettingStarted.description: Keep records of what you do. Your portfolio is built from documentation.

gettingStarted.title: Learn the tools
gettingStarted.description: Master Discord, Telegram, and common community tools.
